cases.description: U+0085 (next line) is White_Space, so the one between `a` and `b` becomes a hyphen and the one at the end is trimmed, giving `a-b` (steps 4 to 6), although JavaScript’s `String.prototype.trim` would leave it; not in GitHub’s capture.
U+2028 (line separator) is White_Space, so the one between `a` and `b` becomes a hyphen and the one at the end is trimmed, giving `a-b` (steps 4 to 6); not in GitHub’s capture.

U+1680 (ogham space mark) is White_Space, so the one between `a` and `b` becomes a hyphen and the one at the end is trimmed, giving `a-b` (steps 4 to 6); not in GitHub’s capture.

Step 2 removes default-ignorable code points before it normalizes to NFC (decision H5.2), so in `e`, U+FE0F, U+0301 the variation selector goes first and the accent then composes, giving `é` (U+00E9), as a heading written `é` does; normalizing first would leave `é`, since the selector blocks composition; not in GitHub’s capture.
The example of §6.3: `## A [link](x.md) & more` gives `a-link--more`; not in GitHub’s capture.
The example of §6.3: `## Größe` gives `größe`, since lower-casing leaves `ß` alone; not in GitHub’s capture.
The example of §6.3: `## What was done ` gives `what-was-done`, with the explicit anchor `done` (decision C13); not in GitHub’s capture.
The example of §6.3 without the space: `## What was done` gives `what-was-done` too, with the explicit anchor `done` (decision C13); not in GitHub’s capture.

Step 2 removes code points unassigned in Unicode 17.0.0 before NFC, so in `a`, U+1ADE, U+0323 the unassigned U+1ADE goes first and `a` then composes with the dot below, giving `ạ` (U+1EA1) on every runtime; Unicode 18 assigns U+1ADE as a combining mark, and without the removal an 18 runtime would give U+1EA1, U+1ADE and a 17 one `a`, U+1ADE, U+0323 (decision O5); not in GitHub’s capture.

Unassigned includes the noncharacters, so in `e`, U+FDD0, U+0301 step 2 removes U+FDD0 before NFC and the accent composes, giving `é` (U+00E9); kept, the noncharacter would block the composition, and step 5 would then remove it, leaving `e` and U+0301 apart (decision O5); not in GitHub’s capture.
